description: SIGTERM to process exit. Matters operationally: supervisord's stopwaitsecs is 10s, and an overrun means SIGKILL mid-write.
blocked_by: Process-level by definition; there is no process to signal in an in-process harness.
notes: Expect a Rust win by construction rather than by optimisation: result_4 bounds shutdown with SHUTDOWN_JOIN_GRACE (2s) plus a hard backstop, engineered against that 10s limit. The reference has no such bound. Say so when reporting.
